headline: Discussion of Waste Management of Londonderry, Inc. curbside trash, recycling, and dumpster pickup service, at $2,689,790 to $3,269,461 a year.
summary: The agenda lists questions and answers with Waste Management representatives about curbside trash, recycling, and dumpster pickup. Public input is also on the agenda.
items: C-27-45: Waste Management of Londonderry, Inc. for curbside trash and recycling pickup, plus dumpster pickup at certain locations
Discussion with Waste Management representatives: questions and answers
location: Great Hall, Searles Building, 3rd. Floor, 41 Pleasant Street, Methuen, MA 01844

Street, Methuen, MA 01844
